basis: The user requested continued research and an investigation of overlooked implications of replicated standalone H512 quality versus worse complete native replacement.
comparison: Existing exact TL3, CP5 replacement, SWA345 replacement, and cached FP32 H512 predictions on the same 468 F0 groups.
observables: Reproduce all three native official scores within 1e-7.
Per-target label-magnitude-weighted covariance, standard deviation, clipping fraction, and H512 partial correlation with the target conditional on TL3.
Exact covariance and variance factor decomposition of the replacement correlation ratio.
Official per-target scores in fixed position bins [99,500), [500,2000), [2000,10000), [10000,20000).
Differential native parity against 0.34 times the FP32 member prediction difference, with raw and individually clipped member outputs. No latent member inference unless the identity holds.
selection: No new coefficients, scale optimization, checkpoint selection, or submission. This is a post hoc diagnostic of fixed predictions.
exposure: Exposed F0 fitted diagnostic; TL3 fitting, teacher, and initializer ancestry remains unknown. Conditional statistics do not establish a causal mechanism or public transfer.
next_test: A separately frozen eight-component native FP32 versus int8 probe, intended to diagnose the current serving path.
